sample_unit: valid responses rated by corneal specialists

links.outcome: Responses judged against scientific consensus by corneal specialists
links.effect: 35% of ChatGPT-3.5 responses were against scientific consensus, decreasing to 5% for GPT-4 (P<0.00001); average grade 2.5 vs 1.4.
links.quote: Approximately a third (35%) of responses from ChatGPT-3.5 were considered against the scientific consensus, a notable rate of error that decreased to only 5% of answers from GPT-4 ( P < 0.00001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5 vs GPT-4 accuracy and scientific consensus regarding Fuchs dystrophy and corneal transplantation by corneal specialists; does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
